en.title: Semiconductor Processing
en.description: Fabrication and sample preparation for advanced electronic and low-dimensional materials research.
en.researchFocus: Custom CVD growth, TorrRHEED-assisted in situ observation, sputtering, thermal evaporation, and lithography-based device preparation.

zh.title: 半導體製程平台
zh.description: 針對先進電子與低維材料研究，進行材料製備與樣品前處理。
zh.researchFocus: 客製化 CVD 成長、TorrRHEED 輔助原位觀測、濺鍍、熱蒸鍍，以及微影元件製作。

en.title: Variable-Temperature Optical Measurement
en.description: Optical and optoelectronic characterization using spectroscopy under variable-temperature conditions.
en.researchFocus: Optical table-based PL measurement with cryostat stage and spectrometer for temperature-dependent optical analysis.

zh.title: 變溫光學量測平台
zh.description: 利用變溫光譜技術，進行光學與光電特性分析。
zh.researchFocus: 整合光學桌、光激發螢光（PL）量測、低溫樣品台與光譜儀，分析溫度相關的光學特性。

en.title: Variable-Temperature Magnetotransport
en.description: Electrical and magnetotransport measurements under controlled temperature and magnetic field conditions.
en.researchFocus: I–V characterization and transport measurements using a cylindrical chamber and dual electromagnets.

zh.title: 變溫磁傳輸量測平台
zh.description: 在可控溫度與磁場條件下，進行電性與磁傳輸量測。
zh.researchFocus: 結合圓柱形腔體與雙電磁鐵，進行電流－電壓（I–V）特性與傳輸量測。

en.title: AI-Assisted Optical Measurement
en.description: Interferometric optical measurement integrated with AI-based data analysis and computation.
en.researchFocus: Michelson interferometer experiments combined with AI-assisted image, signal, and pattern analysis.

zh.title: AI 輔助光學量測平台
zh.description: 整合干涉光學量測與 AI 資料分析及運算。
zh.researchFocus: 結合 Michelson 干涉儀實驗與 AI 輔助影像、訊號及圖樣分析。

en.title: Synchrotron Measurement Team
en.description: Long-term use of synchrotron radiation facilities for advanced materials characterization.
en.researchFocus: External synchrotron-based measurements and long-term beamline access for high-level material analysis.

zh.title: 同步輻射量測團隊
zh.description: 長期使用外部同步輻射設施，進行先進材料特性分析。
zh.researchFocus: 運用外部同步輻射量測與長期光束線研究資源，進行進階材料分析。
